the expression of N protein in baculoviral expression system,which is the first report of N protein of NiV and Hev being expressed in this way in China.
the expression of NiV and Hev N proteins in baculoviral system,and the characterization of their reactivity.
the expression and characterization of N proteins of NiV and He V in the baculovirus expression system,and provides a new approach to the prevention and control of NiV and H ev infections.

the N proteins of NiV and Hev expressed by recombinant baculovirus can react with rabbit anti NiV and anti-HeV antibodies.

the efficient expression system of N proteins of Nipah virus (NiV) and Hendravirus (HeV) has been established in the baculovirus expression vector system (BEVS) and that the proteins can be used as diagnostic or preventive agent.
the expression of N protein from NiV and Hev has been achieved in this study,and the resulted proteins can serve as a potential diagnostic or preventive reagents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the N proteins of NiV and Hev were successfully expressed in baculoviral system,which would provide an important basis for the development of the vaccine and the diagnostic reagent of the two viruses.
the N proteins of NiV and Hev have been successfully expressed and the proteins can be used as diagnostic reagents.
the N protein of NiV and Hev expressed by baculovirus can be used as the antigen for the development of NiV and Henrvirus diagnostic reagents,and also as the vaccine candidate for NiV and He virus.

the efficient expression system of N protein of NiV and Hev in baculoviruses has been established,which can be applied to the research on the prevention and treatment of the NiV and He V diseases in the future.
